name: Yonmoque
author: Mitsuo Yamamoto (Logy Games, 1997)
description: Mitsuo Yamamoto's 5x5 duel on a three-coloured board. Place or move a piece each turn; a piece slides like a bishop only along squares of its own colour, and moving so as to sandwich enemy pieces flips them to your side. Making four in a row with a move wins - but making five in a row, ever, loses.
